prompt:
Scene:
Create a square unlock-reward splash image that feels like a high-impact reveal panel in a live game. Use a centered reveal composition with glowing shards, soft volumetric backlight, and a contained burst of color that feels celebratory rather than explosive. The image should imply a newly earned cosmetic, emote bundle, or social reward without using readable text or explicit logos. Keep the design clean enough to function as a product-facing mockup, with strong central focus and a clear silhouette.

Subject:
Render the same heroine concept independently as the reward focal point: warm brown skin, amber eyes, short silver undercut with teal tips, eyebrow notch, freckles, cropped off-white flight jacket, oversized orange sleeve, charcoal bodysuit, teal scarf ribbon, fingerless gloves, and compact athletic build. Pose her in a confident half-turn as if she has just spun into the spotlight, one hand open toward the viewer and the other resting at the waist. Give her an excited, satisfied smile that suggests an unlock moment rather than combat aggression. Surround her with abstract token fragments, glow plates, or framed reward accents that hint at collectible value without creating brand marks.

Important details:
The test here is whether the same character concept can anchor a monetizable or progression-facing reveal surface while remaining tasteful and clear. Preserve her facial identity, body proportions, and costume cues exactly enough that she still feels like the same hero from the emote and MVP studies. Keep the reward accents secondary, use controlled color harmony around orange, teal, and warm gold, and avoid visual noise that would compete with the face. The final image should feel polished enough for a reward pop-up, social-share unlock banner, or seasonal bundle reveal, with a premium commercial finish and immediate readability.

Use case:
Emote Expression Victory Pose Pack single study 5/5.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no loot-box branding, no extra characters, no anatomy distortion, no noisy particle storm, no costume redesign, no blurry face, no harsh clipping glow.
title: Unlock Reward Splash
description: A reward-reveal mockup that uses the same heroine concept to sell an unlock moment without sacrificing clear identity.
